claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. If N<16 output 0. Else k is the largest integer with 4^k<=N, t=2^k, m0=floor((N-t)/(t+1)), m=m0 if m0 is odd and m=m0-1 otherwise, l=N-t-m-t*m; if m<1 output 0. Bits 1..t define R(W)=W^t+sum_{v<t} x_{v+1}W^v and bits t+1..t+m define Q(Z)=Z^m+sum_{u<m} x_{t+u+1}Z^u over F_2; if R or Q fails the exact irreducibility test of proof.md (X^(2^d)=X mod P, and gcd(P,X^(2^d')-X)=1 for every divisor d' of d=deg P with d'<d) output 0. Otherwise the next t*m bits c_{u,v} (bit number t+m+v*m+u+1) give z=sum c_{u,v}Z^uW^v in the field E=(F_2[Z]/(Q))[W]/(R) with 2^(tm) elements, the last l bits are ignored, and the output is 1 iff z^e=1 for e=sum_{j=0}^{t-1} 2^(m*j). All t+m+l prefix and leftover bits are counted in N; R and Q are input, not advice.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"2613","numerator":"12613"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"2613","numerator":"12613"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For the single fixed total language L defined in proof.md Section 1, its evaluator A runs in polynomial time on every input, and L is in NP with witness bound zero and the verifier accepting exactly empty witnesses with A(x)=1. In the full Li-Yang B2 model at entire input length N, liminf over all integers N tending to infinity of C_B2(L_N)/N is at least 12613/2613. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there exists N_epsilon such that every integer N>=N_epsilon satisfies C_B2(L_N)>=(12613/2613-epsilon)N. Proof: proof.md, circuit.md, cutwidth.md, krs.md, certificate.md and the locally executed Python interval certificate certify.py. No explicit remainder rate is claimed.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

experiments.purpose: Certify the finite Gaussian path sum Gamma_13 < 2613/20000 with directed Decimal interval arithmetic, certified Gauss-Legendre roots/weights and explicit analytic truncation and quadrature error bounds. The supplied proof derives the stationary AR(2) integral and every error bound; the universal graph and circuit arguments are separate written proofs.
